description: Gladly offers a RESTful API and a Lookup API for integrating customer support data, accessed via HTTPS with JSON payloads.

evidence.claim: Gladly provides a REST API accessed via HTTPS with JSON payloads.
Gladly offers a Lookup API that uses REST semantics and is authenticated with secure keys.
API tokens are required to use Gladly APIs and must be created by users with the API role.
